reuse.why: Follows the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked pattern and APIError convention; a raw SELECT is used where db.getAccount could serve, matching the neighbouring guard's style.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in a dedicated guard; only a one-line call is repeated in each of the six already-duplicated provider link functions.

placement.why: A separate named guard sits next to assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts and runs before findOrCreateBank and any write or sync.

scope.why: Only the guard, six calls and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear single-purpose guard that is easy to own; new providers must remember to call both guards since the link bodies are not shared.

one_place.where: assertUpgradingAccountNotClosed in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account handlers
